content_zh:
“秦玄，杀害同门，罪大恶极。
念其对宗门有功，留其性命，赶出宗门。”
广场上，天星门大长老居高临下的蔑视着广场上的一个少年，冰冷的声音传遍整个山门。
“废物东西，滚吧！”
“残害同门的人渣，快滚出宗门。”
“滚吧废物，你不配做天星门弟子。”
听着昔日同门的叫骂，秦玄一脸冷笑，嗓子里像是卡着刀片，难以下咽。
七天前，他本是天星门第一天才，堂堂的天星门少主，风光无限，备受同门崇拜爱戴。
可在带队执行一次刺杀的任务中，却被自己的同门算计，为了保护随行弟子，他独自迎战天罡境的高手，大战了一天一夜，最后被人击碎丹田，重伤逃回宗门。
宗门知道他的丹田破碎后，直接罢黜了他的少主之位，将他赶到外门自生自灭。
秦玄本打算和妹妹在外门就这样过着平静的日子，可他怎么也没有想到，区区一个连真武境都不到的外门弟子，竟然也敢找自己的麻烦。
更可恶的是，这名弟子在住处没有找到他，竟然转头向自己刚踏足武道的妹妹秦灵儿动手，要强上了她。
等秦玄赶回去后，秦灵儿因为反抗已经被打得奄奄一息，浑身是血，不成人样，而那名弟子开始脱掉衣服，要欺身而上。
一怒之下，秦玄用仅存的护身符咒让这名弟子灰飞烟灭，可还来不及给秦灵儿治伤，就被这些人给带到这里接受审判。
……
我为宗门付出这么多，竟然落得这样的下场。
天星无情道！
当真无情！
“昔日我身为天星门少主时，你们对我趋之若鹜，前倨后恭。
如今我丹田被废，沦为废人，只因救妹被迫杀人，你们却对我大张挞伐。”

“如此薄情的同门，如此冷漠的宗门。”
“我秦玄也不屑留在这里。”
秦玄心灰意冷，背着重伤昏迷过去的妹妹，一步一步行至山门，却被一名熟悉的黑衣少年给挡住了去路，少年脸泛讥讽之色：“呦，这不是昔日大名鼎鼎的天才秦少主么，怎么会沦落到这一步呢？”
眼前这个姜易，天星门大长老的弟子，与秦玄同期的天才人物，当年和他竞争天星门少主之位，被他强势击败。
光芒被他掩盖，就连喜欢的女子都喜欢自己，因此一直以来对自己怀恨在心。
只是，昔日因为自己是少主身份，倒也不敢如何，现在自己被废了，驱逐出天星门，倒是第一个跳出来。
秦玄脸色平静，淡淡说道：“今日你能把我赶出天星门，他日你必将有同样的下场。”
“最是天星最无情，你可想过自己的明天？”
看见秦玄沦落到这一步依旧保持着如此平静，一直以来都被他打压的姜易感受不到任何快感，转而看向他身后背着的秦灵儿，露出一抹讥讽：“秦玄，没想到事到如今你还这般嘴硬。
不过，看样子，你妹妹应该被张华得逞了吧？”
闻言，秦玄猛地瞳孔一缩：“姜易，难道这一切都是你——”
因为那个外门弟子，正是张华，被他赶回来所杀之时，根本无其他人在。
只能说明，张华就是姜易所指使的。
秦玄双眼发红欲裂，就连丹田被废都没有这般愤怒过，要冲上去杀了他，但被姜易凌厉一巴掌拍去。
“咔嚓”
content_en:
"Qin Xuan, killing his fellow disciples is a heinous crime.
Thinking of his meritorious service to the sect, he spared his life and drove him out of the sect. "
In the square, the great elder of Tianxing Gate looked down upon a young man in the square, and his cold voice spread throughout the gate.
"You trash, get out of here!"
"The scum who harmed fellow sects should get out of the sect quickly."
"Go away, you loser, you are not worthy of being a disciple of the Tianxing Sect."
Listening to the yelling and scolding of his former classmates, Qin Xuan sneered, as if there was a razor blade stuck in his throat, making it difficult to swallow.
Seven days ago, he was the number one genius of the Tianxing Sect, the majestic young master of the Tianxing Sect, with unlimited fame and great admiration and love from his fellow sects.
However, while leading a team on an assassination mission, he was plotted by his fellow disciples. In order to protect his accompanying disciples, he fought against the Tiangang Realm masters alone. The battle lasted for a day and a night. In the end, his Dantian was shattered and he was seriously injured and escaped back to his sect.
After the sect learned that his Dantian was broken, he immediately deposed him as the young master and drove him to the outer sect to fend for himself.
Qin Xuan originally planned to live a peaceful life with his sister in the outer sect, but he never thought that a mere outer sect disciple who was not even at the Zhenwu realm would dare to cause trouble for him.
What's even more disgusting is that this disciple didn't find him at his residence, so he turned to his sister Qin Ling'er, who had just started martial arts, and wanted to rape her.
When Qin Xuan rushed back, Qin Ling'er had been beaten to death because of her resistance. She was covered in blood and looked like a human being. The disciple began to take off his clothes and wanted to bully him.
In a rage, Qin Xuan used the remaining amulet to make this disciple disappear into ashes, but before he could treat Qin Ling'er's injury, he was brought here for trial by these people.
…
I have sacrificed so much for the sect, yet I ended up like this.
Tianxing Wurudao!
So heartless!
"In the past, when I was the young master of the Tianxing Sect, you all flocked to me, being arrogant at first and respectful at the other.
Now that my Dantian has been destroyed and I have become a useless person, I am forced to kill someone just to save my sister, but you are criticizing me. "
"Such a heartless fellow disciple, such an indifferent sect."
"I, Qin Xuan, don't even bother to stay here."
Qin Xuan was disheartened. He walked to the mountain gate step by step with his sister who was seriously injured and unconscious on his back. However, he was blocked by a familiar young man in black. The young man had a sarcastic look on his face: "Hey, isn't this the famous genius Young Master Qin from the past? How could he have fallen to this point?"
The man in front of him was Jiang Yi, a disciple of the great elder of the Tianxing Sect and a genius at the same time as Qin Xuan. He competed with him for the position of the young master of the Tianxing Sect but was defeated by him.
His light was obscured by him, and even the woman he liked liked him, so he always held a grudge against himself.
However, in the past, because of his identity as the young master, he did not dare to do anything. Now that he has been deposed and expelled from the Tianxing Sect, he is the first to jump out.
Qin Xuan looked calm and said calmly: "If you can drive me out of Tianxing Gate today, you will have the same fate in the future."
"Tianxing is the most ruthless. Have you ever thought about your own tomorrow?"
Seeing Qin Xuan reduced to this point and still maintaining such calmness, Jiang Yi, who had been suppressed by him all the time, could not feel any pleasure, and turned to look at Qin Ling'er who was carrying him behind him, showing a touch of sarcasm: "Qin Xuan, I didn't expect you to be so stubborn now.
However, it seems that your sister should have been succeeded by Zhang Hua, right? "
Hearing this, Qin Xuan's pupils suddenly shrank: "Jiang Yi, is this all because of you -"
Because that outer disciple was none other than Zhang Hua. When he was driven back to kill him, no one else was there at all.
It can only be explained that Zhang Hua was ordered by Jiang Yi.
Qin Xuan's eyes were red and bursting. He had never been so angry even after his Dantian was destroyed. He wanted to rush to kill him, but was slapped away by Jiang Yi.
"Click"
